 Paris Hilton’s New Old Navy Jingle Jammies Collab Is a Pink Holiday Dream 
 Paris Hilton’s New Old Navy Jingle Jammies Collab Is a Pink Holiday Dream 
 We loves it!
 By Megan Uy Published: Nov 17, 2026 12:37 PM EST Save Article Share Article Old Navy We may earn commission from links on this page, but we only recommend products we love. Promise. 
 It’s nearly impossible to think about the holidays without thinking of Old Navy Jingle Jammies. The brand has become a beloved go-to for cute, festive, and affordable seasonal sleepwear, dropping a fresh lineup each year that people can’t get enough of. With so many fun designs and cozy styles, there’s something for every theme and aesthetic. This year, Old Navy is taking things up a notch with a special collaboration with Paris Hilton. And yes, they’re pink. (And yes, there’s even something for your dog, so they can match, too.)
 Whether you’re dressing up for a holiday party with your besties or coordinating a family look for the annual holiday card, these pajamas are a playful alternative to the traditional winter palette. We also got the chance to chat with Paris about everything from the design process and collaborating with her longtime friend Zac Posen, Old Navy’s Chief Creative Officer, to how she’s celebrating the holidays this year. Shop the full collection here!
 Tell me what the creative process was like for designing these exclusive Jingle Jammies.
 I love the holidays, and I love matching with my whole family, so it was so much fun designing these. I wanted them to be the perfect pink and to feel cozy. I love having all of my dogs as the designs. It's really personal to me. I’m so excited.
 This is the first Jingle Jammies collection with matching dog designs. How did that come to be?
 I'm so happy that we did this together. It wouldn't have been the same if we didn't have matching ones for the dogs too, because they are my babies, and I love matching with them.

 $10 at Old Navy Credit: Old Navy You had the iconic summer campaign with your mom, and now this. What's been your favorite part about working with Old Navy and all the cool campaigns?
 It was so much fun working with my mom. I loved that campaign. It was so fun to be on set together, and I love Zac. We've been friends since we were teenagers, and he's so talented and creative. He knows how to make things iconic.
 When they asked me to come back to do this campaign, it was an immediate yes. I love the whole Old Navy team. Everyone is so kind, and it's a family vibe on set. There’s an exciting, fun energy.
 Emily Malan What are your brainstorms with Zac like? Since you guys have been friends for so long, I imagine they’re so much fun.
 We talk about life and the fun memories from back in the day during the 2000s in New York. I love what he's done with Old Navy. The collections are so cute. I was just at the Century City Mall, and I went into the store, and there are so many great pieces. Whatever he touches turns to gold.
 I agree. He's breathed new life into Old Navy. He's doing something different, and he's doing it right.
 Totally, it's really awesome. I'm really, really proud of him.
 Could we get a peek into like what your wind-down routine is like? What do you do to decompress?
 I built an at-home longevity center spa called Maison Parívie, and it has the most high-tech equipment. I love going into the Immortal, which is like a red light therapy machine mixed with PEMF and oxygen. And I love my oxygen chamber. I also get facials with my Parívie skincare line. I invite a lot of my friends to come too, so we all feel like we're walking into the fountain of youth.
 View full post on Instagram Are there any unexpected holiday traditions you and your family have?
 It's my husband's and my fifth wedding anniversary, so we're going on a six-week trip around the world and bringing the babies. It's going to be so special. I can't wait for that. Plus, we love going to Maui. I love being at the Grand Wailea Waldorf Astoria Hotel; it's a family tradition. My sister, my parents, and I have been going since we were two years old. Now I get to go and bring my babies there every Christmas, it’s so nostalgic for me.
 View full post on Instagram What's the most thoughtful gift you have ever received from your husband? And what's the most thoughtful gift he's ever given you?
 He's the best gift giver ever. Every Christmas we go to Chanel, and he basically buys me everything in the store. And last year for our anniversary, he bought me Sliv Air, my pink private jet. That was the most epic gift anyone has ever given me. Loves it! From me, he likes sentimental things. I’ve made these huge canvas art pieces, and I cut out all the pictures and memories, and then glued them on myself. I always love doing sentimental things for him.
 Megan Uy Associate Shopping Editor Megan Uy is an associate shopping editor at Cosmopolitan , where she searches for the best products in all things fashion, home, beauty, sex, gifts, and more, so you don’t have to.
